name: Lark
description: Lark (Larksuite) is an enterprise collaboration platform combining chat, calendar, docs, video conferencing, and custom app integration tools.

evidence.claim: Lark Developer provides tools and resources for developers to create and integrate custom apps, bots, and services within Lark's platform.
Lark supports obtaining OAuth codes and user access tokens via Server APIs.
Lark Developer Documentation acts as a comprehensive hub for guides, tutorials, and server APIs.

notes: Lark provides comprehensive developer tools and robust server APIs, supporting OAuth2 authorization flows and bot/app creation through the Lark Developer platform.
